user.title: Hager Witty Start
user.description: Prepare the connection to your Hager account.

auth.title: Hager login
auth.description:
1. Open [the Hager login page]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in normally.
3. The final redirect starts with `com.miaaguardusercontent...:/callback`; your desktop browser may be unable to open it.
4. Paste the complete callback URL below (preferred), or only the value after `code=` and before the next `&`. Never share this URL.

If device discovery fails after login, submit again to retry within this setup flow.

reauth_confirm.description: The stored Hager authentication is no longer valid. Reconnect your account.
